searchText: will open the call for this week for discussion on the interaction with preconfirmations. I've been given a series of arguments that, while I don't share, I'd like them to have them discussed. Heads up, we should have basic support for EIP-7732 on Kurtosis soon, courtesy of these two PRs—thanks to Pari: https://github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-genesis-generator/pull/176 https://github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-package/pull/880 We also need to update Dora to better display the consensus and execution block pipeline https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1210529202458071050/1333361795762753556 I've seen we have eip7732 support in the genesis generator now 🙂 I've also found the spec updates, but missing some information about the eip7732 beacon api changes. As the execution payload is delayed and no longer part of the BeaconBlockBody, we need a new api to fetch the execution payload from once its ready. And also a event on the eventstream that notifies about new execution payloads? Are there already some details about these things? With that I can get dora and other tools working 🙂 So I haven't thought much about the API but my first impression would be to add a beacon endpoint to get the envelope and this endpoint will call the engine to get the block by hash just as today we unblind a block? Want to come Friday to talk about this? Just confirm here and I'll add both topics to the agenda yea, sounds good 🙂 I think it also makes sense to have a new event for the event steam that notifies about the new execution payload

excerpts.content:
I've seen we have eip7732 support in the genesis generator now 🙂
I've also found the spec updates,  but missing some information about the eip7732 beacon api changes.
As the execution payload is delayed and no longer part of the BeaconBlockBody, we need a new api to fetch the execution payload from once its ready. 
And also a event on the eventstream that notifies about new execution payloads?
Are there already some details about these things? With that I can get dora and other tools working 🙂
